title: Preregistered retrospective X-partition remedy study
terminology: <!--TERMINOLOGY_DISCLAIMER--> This is a RETROSPECTIVE remedy / retrospective few-shot recovery study. ZR/TI/CO/SI/AG/MO targets historically exist and were evaluated in STEP5C; nothing here is prospective, blind, or never-seen. The prospective blind unseen-element test (Ni) remains sealed and is NOT part of STEP5E. <!--/TERMINOLOGY_DISCLAIMER-->
primary_task_only: X partition (spec 12); presence/fraction/Cr/Nb are NOT retrained
fold_data_source: STEP5C LOEO_MASTER_FOLD_MANIFEST.csv roles reused verbatim; features from the frozen STEP5A candidate parquet (Domain A only)

candidate_branches.Z2: affinity-enhanced direct XGBoost (STEP5C fold XGB hyperparameters)
candidate_branches.Z3: topology-first XGBoost on original fold features

affinity_descriptors.source: matminer Miedema featurizer (deterministic implementation of Miedema's model with the de Boer et al. 1988 parameter tables, shipped inside matminer)
affinity_descriptors.quantity: Miedema_deltaH_inter at equiatomic 50:50 composition (intermetallic formation enthalpy, Miedema model)
affinity_descriptors.composition_definition: equiatomic 50:50 binary, identical for all six X and all three base partners (spec 21)
affinity_descriptors.sign_convention: taken verbatim from the source; no absolute values
affinity_descriptors.ni_rule: the matminer parameter table may contain Ni; Ni pairs are NEVER queried; descriptor table contains only ZR TI CO SI AG MO (spec 23)
affinity_descriptors.filtering: finite + constant + exact-duplicate check only; no heldout-aware selection; no new PCC (spec 27)

topology_first.principle: 96.696% of summed X-partition TVD comes from wrong-dominant-topology states (STEP5D frozen finding); hierarchical target formulation
topology_first.stage1_target: dominant family = argmax of TRUE X-partition vector over the five core families; labels from FOLD_TRAIN only (spec 32)
topology_first.classifier: XGBoost multiclass, fixed family; preregistered validation-only grid: [{'n_estimators': 300, 'max_depth': 6, 'learning_rate': 0.05}, {'n_estimators': 300, 'max_depth': 6, 'learning_rate': 0.1}, {'n_estimators': 300, 'max_depth': 8, 'learning_rate': 0.05}, {'n_estimators': 300, 'max_depth': 8, 'learning_rate': 0.1}, {'n_estimators': 600, 'max_depth': 6, 'learning_rate': 0.05}, {'n_estimators': 600, 'max_depth': 6, 'learning_rate': 0.1}, {'n_estimators': 600, 'max_depth': 8, 'learning_rate': 0.05}, {'n_estimators': 600, 'max_depth': 8, 'learning_rate': 0.1}] selected on fold-validation multiclass macro F1 (spec 33)
topology_first.stage2: topology-conditional XGBoost regressor per dominant class k (same hyperparameters as Z2), trained on FOLD_TRAIN states with true dominant topology == k (spec 35)

expert_support_thresholds.else: global direct-regressor fallback (original features, Z2 hyperparameters)

topology_first.routing: hard routing: predict dominant topology -> route to the conditional regressor -> simplex projection (spec 37)
topology_first.oracle: ORACLE_TOPOLOGY_CONDITIONAL routes with TRUE topology; labelled DIAGNOSTIC_ORACLE, excluded from candidate ranking (spec 39-40)

simplex_projection: clip negatives to 0; renormalize to sum 1; sum==0 -> fold-train mean simplex; never uses held-out labels (spec 30)
zero_shot_primary_metrics: per-fold mean_tvd for every branch (spec 61: never average-only)

zero_shot_selection_rule.guardrail: candidate must beat the fold-train trivial baseline on >=3/6 folds AND mean topology accuracy must not be below Z0's
zero_shot_selection_rule.fallback: if the lowest-TVD candidate fails the guardrail, take the lowest-TVD candidate satisfying it; if none does, keep the Z0/Z1 baseline that better satisfies the rule
zero_shot_selection_rule.purpose: this selection defines the FUTURE Ni zero-shot pipeline; few-shot results never influence it (spec 43)

few_shot.purpose: answer whether the failure is caused by missing direct chemical anchors; NOT the final Ni model (spec 44, 78)
few_shot.split_rule: for each held-out element, order its 5,250 Domain-A compositions by SHA256('{element}|{composition_id}|20260908') ascending; the lowest 30% (~1575) = CALIBRATION_POOL, the remaining 70% (~3675) = RETROSPECTIVE_RECOVERY_EVAL; verified at freeze time (spec 46)
few_shot.eval_terminology: RECOVERY_EVAL is only the internal non-calibration subset; it is NOT historically untouched (STEP5C evaluated it) (spec 47)
few_shot.each_composition: all available temperature rows enter calibration together; MO@950 failures not interpolated (spec 48)
few_shot.random_strategy: 3 independent replicate sequences, deterministic SeedSequence children of the master seed; nested prefixes of one 32-composition permutation (spec 50)
few_shot.targeted_strategy: target-free greedy maximin in composition-level feature space (Temperature_C and fold-constant columns removed; StandardScaler fit on FOLD_TRAIN only); first pick = largest 1-NN distance to FOLD_TRAIN, then maximize the minimum distance to FOLD_TRAIN + already selected (spec 51-53)

architectures.F0: direct Tree formulation (fold features, Z2 hyperparameters)
architectures.F1: affinity + topology-first XGBoost (Z4 configuration); degrades to topology-first if affinity BLOCKED

few_shot.no_retuning: no Optuna, no feature reselection, no threshold policy change after calibration labels are added; only weights/trees are refit on FOLD_TRAIN + selected calibration compositions (spec 56-57)
few_shot.b_skill: smallest budget whose TVD < fold-train trivial TVD; >32 if never
few_shot.b_topo50: smallest budget with topology accuracy >= 0.50; >32 if never
few_shot.random_vs_targeted: per budget: targeted TVD, random mean/std, difference, targeted percentile among random replicates; no pseudo state-level significance tests (spec 63)

internal_success_criteria.zero_shot_practical: 6-fold mean TVD -10% vs Z0 AND topology accuracy improved AND >=3/6 folds beat trivial
internal_success_criteria.zero_shot_strong: 6-fold mean TVD -25% vs Z0 AND >=4/6 folds beat trivial
internal_success_criteria.few_shot_rapid: <=8 compositions beat trivial AND relative TVD reduction >=25%
internal_success_criteria.note: internal only, never lowered post hoc (spec 79-80)

seeds.derivation: numpy SeedSequence([20260908, replicate]) for random replicate r; split ordering via SHA256 text

seals.DomainB: not used for tuning, descriptor selection, few-shot calibration, or zero-shot model selection

immutability: STEP5C primary predictions/metrics/freezes/features and STEP5D diagnostic outputs are read-only; STEP5E only copies/references
